result.description: Compact wireless expansion card for ultraportable laptops and embedded systems, offering dual-band Wi‑Fi 6 and Bluetooth 5.3 over a PCIe 1-lane / USB interface. The low-profile 2230 form factor is designed for compatibility with space-constrained devices that need reliable network connectivity rather than local storage. Includes integrated antenna pads and driver support for modern Windows and Linux platforms.
